'''Call Of The Hive''' (or more simply COTH) is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the Mod. This Effect is necessary in the propagation of Assimilated Mobs during the first [[Evolution Phases]]. This effect can stack.

COTH cannot be removed by drinking Milk.

== ''Function'' ==
COTH has 3 levels of potency, each of them will be applied when the previous finishes. 

*COTH I: No effect.
*COTH II: The Mob is in the process of Assimilation. It will fake to be a normal Mob, spreading COTH to nearby Mobs, but not through walls. If brought to low Health,<ref name=":0">Below 30% health by default.</ref> the Mob will remove its disguise, turning into an [[Incomplete Forms|Incomplete Form]].
*COTH III: The Mob is assimilated. The now [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mob]], if it can disguise, will fake to be a normal Mob, spreading COTH to nearby Mobs, but not through walls. Each time the timer of COTH III finishes, it will be reapplied. If brought to low Health,<ref name=":0" /> the Assimilated Mob will remove its disguise, turning into its Assimilated Variant. Assimilated Mobs can turn into a normal mob with COTH III, becoming disguised. 
**From Evolution Phase 5 and up, disguised mobs will immediately undisguised, effectively killing all mobs with COTH. Being in range of a [[Stage I Dispatcher|Dispatcher]] will cause this effect regardless of the current COTH potency.
**In case a Mob that does not have an Assimilated Variant reaches this Stage, it will turn into an Incomplete Form. 
**If the Evolution Phase is 6 or greater, and the mob has a [[:Category:Feral Parasites|Feral Form]], it will become Feral instead.
*COTH can stack above level III, but any potency above III will have the same effects as if the potency was III.

COTH works differently for Players.

*Players can spread COTH.
*Unlike all Assimilated Mobs, Players will generate [[Assimilated Adventurer|their Assimilated version]] only at death.
*When COTH's timer ends, it will reapply with higher potency. Stops at potency III, if already at the third level it will not change.
*COTH does not affect the player in any other way.

Keep in mind, this list is incomplete.  There are a wide variety of ways entities can contract COTH, from every parasite.

=== Prevention ===
With the usage of the [[Camouflage]] Effect, it is possible to partially protect Mobs from Call of the Hive. It is still advisable to keep Mobs that you do not want assimilated away from all sources of COTH.
